title: Commissioning: no input responds
summary: First power-up of the conveyor cell after installation. Nothing happens when Start is pressed. Work through the commissioning checklist to find out why.
objectives: Verify power and module status before testing devices
Recognize a missing field supply from module status and input quality
starterProgram:
PROGRAM Main
VAR_INPUT
    StartPB : BOOL; (* Start button S1, normally open: TRUE while pressed. *)
    StopPB : BOOL; (* Stop button S2, normally closed: TRUE while NOT pressed. *)
    GuardClosed : BOOL; (* Guard door switch B2: TRUE while the door is closed. *)
    PartAtEnd : BOOL; (* Part sensor B1: TRUE while a part waits at the conveyor end. *)
    MotorFeedback : BOOL; (* Contactor K1 auxiliary contact. *)
    OverloadOK : BOOL; (* Overload relay F1, normally closed. *)
    ValveOpen : BOOL; (* Cooling valve Y1 open limit switch. *)
    ValveClosed : BOOL; (* Cooling valve Y1 closed limit switch. *)
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    MotorContactor : BOOL; (* Contactor coil K1. *)
    CoolingValve : BOOL; (* Cooling valve solenoid Y1. *)
    RunLamp : BOOL; (* Run lamp H1. *)
END_VAR
VAR
    Running : BOOL; (* Start/stop latch. *)
END_VAR
(* The program was accepted at the factory test; this lab is about the installation. *)
Running := (StartPB OR Running) AND StopPB AND OverloadOK AND GuardClosed AND NOT PartAtEnd;
MotorContactor := Running;
CoolingValve := Running AND MotorFeedback;
RunLamp := MotorFeedback AND ValveOpen;
END_PROGRAM
instructions: Build & Load the program and switch the PLC to RUN; close the guard door and press Start to see the symptom.
Open the Commissioning tab and work through it from POWER to PROCESS.
Operate every button and sensor, and switch every output, until no check is left untested.
hints: Start with POWER and HARDWARE before testing single devices.
Every input reading FALSE at once rarely means every device failed.

scenarios.title: Close the guard, start and stop the machine

criteria.title: The conveyor motor runs after Start
criteria.onFail: The motor does not run after Start with the guard closed.

criteria.title: The run lamp reports the machine running
criteria.onFail: The run lamp never lit: motor feedback and an open cooling valve are both needed.

criteria.title: Stop stops the motor
criteria.onFail: The motor kept running after Stop.

troubleshooting.symptom: Machine does not start. The guard door is closed and Start was pressed several times.
troubleshooting.reportedBy: Electrician, first power-up of conveyor cell 3

diagnosisOptions.label: The input module has no 24 V field supply
The guard door switch has the wrong contact type (NC instead of NO)
The Start and Stop buttons are wired to each other's inputs
The contactor and the cooling valve are wired to each other's outputs
The contactor's auxiliary feedback does not reach its input
The input module sits in the wrong slot

repairs.label: Replace the blown fuse in the input module's 24 V field supply

debrief.rootCause: The input module had no 24 V field supply. Without it the module cannot detect any closed contact, so every input read FALSE: the normally closed Stop button and the guard door switch both looked open, and the start latch could never set.
evidence: The Hardware checks showed the input module's status LED flashing red and a diagnostic for missing field supply.
All inputs read FALSE with bad quality, including the normally closed Stop button, which must read TRUE at rest.
The CPU was in RUN and the program was unchanged, so the program was not the cause.
debrief.repair: Restore the input module's 24 V field supply, then repeat the input checks and the start test.
debrief.reasoning: Commission in order: power, hardware, then individual signals. When every signal of one module is wrong at the same time, suspect what the channels share: the module, its slot and its supply.
